faq.a: Yes. Subscriptions run monthly or annually. You cancel in one click in the admin Billing section. Your account stays active until the end of your prepaid period.

faq.q: What if I exceed booking or staff limits?
faq.a: We email you and propose an upgrade. No surprise charges — we never bill extra without your explicit consent.
100 SMS/month are included in Starter and higher plans. Above that, roughly 1.50 CZK per SMS. Email is always free.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain (e.g. booking.mysalon.com)?
faq.a: Yes, on Business and Enterprise plans. Starter / Pro get a subdomain (mysalon.reserved.cz).

faq.q: Do you take a commission on bookings?
faq.a: No. No booking fees, no marketplace, no 'new customer fee'. You only pay the monthly subscription.

faq.q: What if I have special requirements (custom integrations, SLA, SSO)?
faq.a: Check out the Enterprise plan or email sales@reserved.cz — we'll prepare a custom quote.

aboutPage.title: We're building Reserved for Czechia
aboutPage.subtitle: Software for salons and clinics that's fair to operators and their clients alike.
aboutPage.whyP1: We watched Czech salons pay 20% commission to foreign marketplaces for 'acquiring' clients who would have come anyway. Existing systems were either outdated (Reservanto, Reservio) or too expensive for small operators (SimplyBook, Calendly).
aboutPage.whyP2: We decided to build a modern booking system for the Czech and European market — fair to operators (no booking commissions), integrated with the Czech ecosystem (POHODA, Fakturoid, GoPay, QR payments), with a focus on modern UX.

values.v1Text: No marketplace, no commission. When a client picks you, no one stands between you.
values.v2Text: Fixed monthly subscription. No hidden fees, no Custom Features at extra cost.
values.v3Text: Including support, documentation, legal documents, and integrations with Czech accounting.
values.v4Text: If you want to build your own integration or mobile app, you have the full documentation.
values.v5Text: Bank-grade data isolation (PostgreSQL RLS), GDPR compliant, encryption of sensitive fields.
